headline: BBC DROPS 💦 Drag Race UK After EIGHT 📺 Series 🏳️‍🌈
text:
BBC 📡 just PULLED 🫳 the plug 🔌 on RuPaul's Drag Race UK after a THROBBING 🍆 eight series run that had the whole queer 🌈 community EDGE 🫦 for more!! The broadcaster's spokesperson came 🗣️ out swinging 🥊 admitting they're facing some very difficult choices 🍒 amid significant financial pressures 💸 that left them no choice but to send the show packing 📦 to Wow Presents Plus streaming 🍑 platform!! At its PEAK ⛰️ the UK version was pulling around 1.5 million viewers 👀 per episode which is basically the entire twink 🍆 and bear 🐻 population glued to their screens every week!! They say they're still proud 🏆 of this groundbreaking show and thanked RuPaul 👠 World of Wonder and everyone involved both on and off screen but we all know it's about that cold hard cash 🤑 making them pull out early ⏰.

The show started back in 2019 🎉 and straight up brought British drag 👠 into the mainstream 🏠 making household names 🏷️ of legends like La Voix 🎤 Danny Beard 🧔 and Tia Kofi who served absolute LEWKS 💅 every single time!! It sees drag queens 👑 competing in a series of challenges to impress judges RuPaul 👨‍🦰 Michelle Visage 💄 Graham Norton ☕ and Alan Carr 🍷 often with big name celebrity guest judges popping in to sprinkle that extra fairy dust ✨ on the runway!! The corporation is currently rolling out plans to make 500 million pounds 💷 of savings with director general Matt Brittin telling staff the scale requires tough choices that apparently include edging 🖐️ this particular fan favorite right off BBC Three 📺 and iPlayer!! A new era 🌅 of Drag Race UK is coming they say but now it's all behind the paywall of Wow Presents Plus which hits different 😩 when you're a broke queen 👸 just trying to watch her sisters SLAY 🗡️.

Tia Kofi the winner of RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs The World series two in 2024 dropped some serious truth tea 🍵 on BBC Radio 4's Today programme saying the programme has until now provided a platform for performers who otherwise lack mainstream representation!! Cutting the show also means a marginalised audience now has nowhere to go she explained while reminding everyone that niche audiences are the ones staying ON 📍 and watching these things religiously like the devoted little bottoms 🍑 we are!! She pointed out the mistake in dropping programmes they consider for more niche audiences because it leaves limited representation in mainstream media especially after they also axed I Kissed a Boy 💋 I Kissed a Girl and the Rap Game UK which all served that sweet sweet visibility we CRAVE 🥺.

Last year's runner up Elle Vosque told BBC Newsbeat that taking the show off the BBC where it's accessible to everyone would make it more challenging for people to discover drag because you could be flicking through channels 📺 and just FALL 🍂 upon the show ending up loving it even if you've never been exposed before!! Fan Alex Re agrees saying for that young queer kid 🧒 sat at home wanting community and something to relate to that's now behind something they have to pay for which feels like losing that kind of access and it's a worry that kids aren't going to have that safe space anymore!! The current series which launched in September 2026 will still air as normal on BBC Three and iPlayer with all existing series staying available but after that it's strictly Wow Presents Plus only which has the whole fandom feeling down bad 😔 and wondering where their next fix is coming from.

The BBC does still represent the LGBTQ+ community through storylines in a bunch of other shows like Mr Loverman 💑 Rob & Rylan's Grand Tour 🚌 Amandaland 🏡 EastEnders 🏘️ What It Feels Like For a Girl 👗 The Dickie Show 🎙️ Vigil 🕵️ Smoggie Queens 👑 Such Brave Girls 💪 and Juice 🧃 but apparently that wasn't enough to keep this groundbreaking drag competition on their books!! They declined to comment on whether future series of other international versions like Drag Race Canada 🇨🇦 and Drag Race Down Under 🇦🇺 would continue to air which leaves everyone feeling a little nervous about the whole franchise getting railed 💦 by budget cuts!! Wow Presents Plus announced on Instagram that a new series Drag Race UK All Stars seeing previous fan favourites return will premiere in Autumn 2027 exclusively on their platform and honestly it feels like the end of an era while also the start of something that might just leave us all paying for that sweet drag 🏳️‍🌈 representation we used to get for free on the BBC!!
